scholarships.name: Academic Distinction Scholarship
scholarships.description: UICC is committed to helping students achieve their academic goals by offering scholarships to outstanding students. Each semester, UICC awards three students with Academic Distinction Scholarships. The scholarship award is equivalent to $1,000.

scholarships.name: Exceptional Academic Performance Scholarships
scholarships.description: UICC awards students at the top of the pathway program with Exceptional Academic Performance Scholarships each semester. The scholarship award is equivalent to $750.

scholarships.name: Resiliency Award Scholarships
scholarships.description: UICC recognizes and celebrates students overcoming adversity in the pursuit of completing their academic program. Each semester, UICC awards two students with Resiliency Award Scholarships. The scholarship award is equivalent to $250.

scholarships.name: Community Engagement Scholarships
scholarships.description: Each semester, UICC awards two students with Community Engagement Scholarships. The scholarship award is equivalent to $250.
